question: What protection from untimely death results from daily worship of this yantra?
premises: This yantra is the previously described Mṛtyuñjaya instrument.
A person may worship this yantra daily.
Untimely death is destroyed for that worshipper.
inference: Daily worship of this yantra removes untimely death.
plain_english: Whoever worships this yantra daily has untimely death destroyed.
